description: List time entries in a matter, optionally filtered by workItemId (the document, folder, or task providing context), userId or scope=me, a date-worked range (dateFrom/dateTo, ISO YYYY-MM-DD), and status. Returns each entry's id, entity, user, date, minutes, rate (minor currency units), currency, narrative, and status.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page

dateFrom.description: List only entries worked on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateTo.description: List only entries worked on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)

scope.description: List only entries recorded by the signed-in user

status.description: List only entries with this status

userId.description: List only entries recorded by this user

workItemId.description: List only entries carrying this optional document, folder, or task context
